en: Black‑and‑white night view of a snowy European square with a large baroque fountain in the foreground. The multi‑tiered fountain is topped by a trident‑holding figure and surrounded by statues at its base, all covered with snow. Behind it stand several multi‑story historic buildings with shuttered windows and arcades at street level. Leafless tree branches frame the upper edge of the image, and shopfronts with illuminated signs are visible along the ground floor.
